description: This file defines the 'TimeUntilDisconnectNotification' class, which encapsulates information about a device’s readiness to receive messages, including properties like tenant ID, device ID, time-to-disconnect (TTD), and expiration details. It includes methods for creating instances from message objects, computing expiry times, and retrieving formatted identifiers.

classes.name: TimeUntilDisconnectNotification
classes.description: Final class representing a notification about device disconnection timing, providing properties and factory methods related to device connection status.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a TimeUntilDisconnectNotification instance from an AMQP message by extracting relevant properties and calculating the ready until instant.

methods.name: getMillisecondsUntilExpiry
methods.description: Calculates the remaining milliseconds until the notification expires, considering unlimited duration as a maximum value.
